VideoDownload.title: VideoDownload
VideoDownload.description: Represents a video download initiated by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the video download.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated the download. (Relationship: User 1:N VideoDownload)

url.description: The URL of the video being downloaded.

quality.description: The selected video quality (resolution) for the download.

status.description: The current status of the download (e.g., 'pending', 'downloading', 'completed', 'failed').

filePath.description: The file path on the device where the video is saved after download.

downloadedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the download was completed.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Video Grabber application.

email.description: The email address of the user.

joinDate.description: Timestamp indicating when the user joined the application.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The 'userId' parameter identifies the user's document ID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores video download information for a specific user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who initiated the download.

params.name: downloadId
params.description: The unique identifier of the video download.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure secure and scalable data management for the Video Grabber application, adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC (Database-Based Access Control), and QAPs (Rules are not Filters). It leverages structural segregation to achieve a homogeneous security posture.

**Authorization Independence:**
*   The `videoDownloads` subcollection under each user denormalizes the `userId` within each document. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls to parent `users` documents in security rules, enabling atomic operations and simplifying rule logic.

**Structural Segregation:**
*   User-specific data (video downloads) is stored under `/users/{userId}/videoDownloads/{downloadId}`, ensuring clear ownership and access control.

**Access Modeling:**
*   **Private Data:** The `/users/{userId}/videoDownloads/{downloadId}` path follows the Path-Based ownership pattern, ensuring only the user can access their downloads.

**QAPs Support:**
*   The path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}/videoDownloads/{downloadId}`) enables efficient and secure `list` operations. Rules can easily filter downloads based on `request.auth.uid` without needing complex filtering logic.

This structure provides a clear, maintainable, and secure foundation for the Video Grabber application.
